gloss_en: The destruction and uprooting of the books of the heretics (sifrei ha-minin) — the on-high kal vachomer outcome in Likutey Moharan II:32 whereby, since even God's holy Name/holy books may be erased for the sake of peace, the heresy-spreading books that cast hatred and strife among Israel are all the more surely blotted out and eradicated
